title: His horns: Holton, Conn and Buescher; cornet to trumpet; banjo, sax, tuba
summary: Charles describes switching between instruments, getting a Buescher about a year before quitting, and instrumentation changes.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: about, your instruments. Were most of the instruments that you used American made?

Yes. The first one was a Holton. Then I bought corn. Then I thought the corn wasn't hard enough, I went back to the Holton. And I used the Holton and it looked like it could stand more punishment, you see. Corn was a little, when you blow a little too hard it looked like it would blast. I didn't like blasting instruments. I liked the tone if the thing I wanted out of the instruments. And so I bought a busher, the last one I bought a busher for Mr. Warline.
Is that right? And what instrument was this? What was it? Trumpet. You didn't play cornette then?
That was cornette when we first started with Holton.
I noticed the cornet in your hand here. That's right, that's Holton.

And then your corn was a trumpet? No, the busher was a trumpet. The next one I went to was the Holton, I mean the corn was a trumpet. And the Holton first, that was a cornet. Then I bought another cornet but that wasn't the Holton, that was the corn. I didn't like it so well so I changed back to the Holton. Then I left the Holton and went
to the busher. And was your second Holton, was that a- That was my second Holton. Was it a cornet or a trumpet?
The busher was the only one. And when did you get your busher? How long
before you quit? Oh just about a year, just about a year before I quit. So around 1924, 1925, around that trumpet were coming in and corn was going on.
That's right, that's right, because we were doing nothing but cornette, doing those days.
When did the banjo come into the string bands? Just about that same time. Just about, because
Willie San Diego was playing banjo with us. Saxophone had already come in.
A little before that, the saxophone. Yeah. And did they ever use tuba in the dance bands? Oh they just started using that on the
last, but most of the time we were using the string bass.
